name: command-ship
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production UI illustration, isolated flagship asset for a playful local computer fleet application.
Create ONE exquisitely designed miniature command spacecraft, a tangible collectible industrial desk toy. This is the master visual asset of a coherent UI illustration family. Charming and inventive but not childish, no face. Compact chunky rounded rectangular warm ivory ceramic-coated metal hull, deep navy inset panels, burnt orange structural brackets and antenna fittings, small mint status light lenses. A distinctive offset bridge, a tiny radar dish and two stubby communication antennae, rear paired engine pods. Engine nozzles unlit. Functional modular detailing, few bold forms, subtle seams, no excessive greebles. Orthographic three-quarter isometric view from above, nose points toward lower left, top and front-left visible. Soft broad upper-left studio key light, restrained ambient occlusion, satin matte materials, high-quality stylized 3D render, crisp silhouette readable at 120px. Entire ship centered, generous 15 percent transparent margin, no floor, no pedestal, no background, no cast ground shadow, no text, numbers, lettering, logos or watermark. Actual transparent background. Single asset only. Palette and proportions must be suitable for subsequent matching compute ship, dock and status tokens.
